summary: Computes sqrt(this[62]^2 - this[70]^2), stores it to this[71], then computes the ratio this[70] / this[62] and stores it to this[72] after a float-conversion wrapper call. Begins with a no-op/logging wrapper call and always returns 0.

operations.description: Invoke WrapperReturn0 (no-op/logging wrapper) at function entry.
Compute sqrt(this[62] * this[62] - this[70] * this[70]) and store the result to this[71] (offset 0x11C).
Compute the ratio this[70] / this[62] into a temporary double v2.
Invoke FloatConvertWrapper (float format conversion wrapper) between computing and storing the ratio.
Store the ratio v2 to this[72] (offset 0x120).

unresolved: Field semantics are unproven: the stored this[71] and this[72] are consistent with a length and an angle ratio (opposite/hypotenuse), but that interpretation is DERIVED from prose, not independently confirmed.
Effects of WrapperReturn0 and FloatConvertWrapper are unknown; they are treated as opaque wrappers.
